property_summary: After Alice deposits 1 ether and Bob deposits 1 ether, when Alice withdraws, the buggy contract sends the entire contract balance (2 ether) instead of just Alice's balance, causing the contract's ether balance to become 0 instead of 1.
change_summary: Change the external call to use address(this).balance instead of tmp__1, sending the full contract balance instead of the caller's balance.
